text:
hana: heads up i'm planning a staged change for config.runtime.routing_throttle tonight — initial cohort 12% to divert noisy tenants away from low-latency pools. want a 'Preview + validate' step in console before we apply. cc @lucas @priya
lucas: +1. product wants a one-click preflight that returns cost & quota diffs and a short risk summary. can the backend return top-5 affected tenants?
hana: draft preview link: /console/configs/runtime/routing_throttle?preview=true. payload example in preview (shown in UI) and a dry_run=true option.
priya: telemetry asks: map trace_id -> config_version, and emit metric config.rollout.qps.delta. create a temporary alert if canary p95 > 240ms for 10m. also need token-cost-by-tenant panel.
omar: strong ask for dry_run mode that simulates routing decisions and spikes metrics but doesn't change weights. run synthetic traffic against dry-run for ~10-15m. add sample_rate=0.4 for canary.
hana: backend contract suggestion: POST /api/configs/preview_apply?dry_run=true. response should be a flat validation report: estimated_qps_shift, estimated_cost_delta, top_tenants (list), telemetry_hints. curls: `curl -X POST /api/configs/preview_apply?dry_run=true -d @payload.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
devops-bot: deploybot: synthetic/dry-run job scheduled (job id dry-822). ETA 8m. :hourglass:
lucas: UI: show a compact preflight card: cost delta, quota delta, affected customers, risk level (green/amber/red), links to open tenant detail pages. product will sign off on that.
priya: add an auto-pause policy: if temporary SLO p95>200ms for canary for 15m -> pause rollout, notify owners, and mark config as "paused_by_telemetry" with version tag. also include an automatic rollback option in the playbook.
omar: add a small canary header x-rw-canary-id so downstream services can surface the routing decision in logs. console should show example header and a lookup helper to trace request id -> config version.
hana: schedule: start 01:15 PT. rollout stages: 12% -> 35% -> 65% -> 100% with 25m observation windows. i will post progress in this thread.
lucas: i'll wire up the dashboard panels and temporary SLOs. i'll also add a short runbook snippet to the console: how to pause, how to pin fallback routing, how to force-apply a rollback. rollback example: `curl -X POST /api/configs/apply -d '{"key":"config.runtime.routing_throttle","value":0.0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
priya: for the preflight report, please include a small heuristic-based risk score that accounts for top-customer exposure and predicted p95 delta. product likes a single-page yes/no decision.
hana: thanks. planning to push preview now and kick off dry-run synthetic. will hold on the actual apply until we see the preflight report and synthetic results. ping here if you see anything off.
devops-bot: monitorbot: dry-run synthetic started (dry-822). logs: /infra/jobs/dry-822/logs
lucas: got the dry-run metrics — initial charts look fine, p95 stable, cost impact small. sharing dashboard link.
priya: good. leave auto-pause enabled. if p95 drifts, we want the system to stop progression automatically and post the reason + traces.
hana: perfect. thanks team — i'll await thumbs and flip the first stage tonight after 01:15 PT. :rocket:
